name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 8 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 50 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-08-11, at wavelengths from 1.17 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
